title: azalea periclymenoides var. alba
intro: Azalea periclymenoides var. alba, commonly known as White Swamp Azalea, is a deciduous shrub native to the southeastern United States, characterized by its white, funnel-shaped flowers and glossy, dark green leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Azalea periclymenoides var. alba include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
